items.title: Skip sending request bodies to Routing Middleware
items.summary: You can now skip sending client request bodies to  with . This reduces incoming  usage for middleware invocations and can improve time to first byte, especially for requests with large bodies.Routing MiddlewareFast Origin TransferskipMiddlewareRequestBodyEnable this option only if your Routing Middleware doesn’t read request bodies. Vercel Functions and rewrite targets still receive the body, so you can read and process it there.Set  to  in your project’s JSON configuration file, :skipMiddlewareRequestBodytruevercel.jsonIf you use a TypeScript configuration file, add the same setting to  instead. This example assumes  is installed:vercel.ts@vercel/configRedeploy your project for the change to take effect. The option defaults to , so existing projects are unchanged unless you enable it.falseRead more in the .skipMiddlewareRequestBody documentationRead more
